_comment: Template, not yet applied (docs/SPEC.md §11, docs/deploy.md). Mirrors bucket-policy.dev.json but scoped to the PROD bucket's own ARN and prefix (prod uses no S3_KEY_PREFIX — see deploy/env/web.env.example's comment on that var) once that bucket exists. Public GetObject is scoped to exactly the prefixes apps/web's storefront renders publicly (products/* and content/*) plus healthcheck/* (packages/storage's storage:check script). Everything else stays private. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PROD_BUCKET_NAME below, then apply with `pnpm --filter @ammari/storage policy:apply -- --env prod` (see docs/deploy.md). This _comment key is stripped by the apply script before calling PutBucketPolicy.
